fields.name: featureId
fields.description: Owning Feature.ItemId. A test case is always attached to a single feature (which itself belongs to a project + environment). Required.

fields.name: flowId
fields.description: Owning Flow.ItemId. Required. Test cases are now scoped to a Flow rather than to the parent Feature — the spreadsheet reads by flowId. The featureId field stays for traceability but is no longer the lookup key.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Short name of the test case — what is being verified. Required.

fields.name: steps
fields.description: Numbered list of steps the QA should perform. Free-form text — the spreadsheet cell shows a multi-line editor on focus.

fields.name: expectedResult
fields.description: What should happen if the feature works correctly. Free-form text.

fields.name: actualResult
fields.description: What actually happened on the most recent run. Free-form text. QA fills this in after execution.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Execution status. One of: untested/pass/fail/blocked/skipped. Default 'untested' on creation.

fields.name: assignedTo
fields.description: OIDC `sub` of the QA who owns this test case. Empty / unset means unassigned.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Display order within the feature's test sheet. Stringified numeric — the app layer stamps it on creation (e.g. '0', '10', '20' for sparse inserts) and sorts lexicographically; smaller values come first. Optional — missing values fall back to insertion order.

fields.name: isDeletable
fields.description: When false, the spreadsheet renders the Delete action as disabled (greyed out, click-blocked) and the delete mutation refuses the row. Used to lock the 10 placeholder rows the spreadsheet auto-creates so they stay visible as an editable skeleton. Optional — missing / unset is treated as true (deletable) so existing rows are unaffected.
